clue.text: Tempers raised by a woman's retaining a pound

indicators.note: retaining means the woman's name holds the following letters within it

parts.note: Anne is a woman's name, with the possessive S
L is the abbreviation for a pound (libra)

explanation.surface: A woman's temper flares as she keeps hold of a pound coin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised by' is link padding; 'retaining' puts A and L inside ANNE'S.
explanation.definitionFit: Annealing metal or glass is heating and cooling it to toughen it, which is what tempering does.

clue.text: Name wrong ace — such a bloomer

indicators.note: wrong means the letters of name are put wrongly, rearranged

parts.note: an ace is the one in a suit of cards

explanation.surface: Calling the ace by the wrong name is a real blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' means a blunder on the surface but a flowering plant here.
explanation.definitionFit: A windflower, a plant grown for its bright blooms.

clue.text: Her charges are small

parts.note: sounds like a woman with low fees, but her charges are the little children in her care

explanation.surface: A woman whose fees are modest.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman employed to look after young children, who are in her charge.

clue.text: Before noon, the aim is to revise

parts.note: AM, ante meridiem, means before noon
the end one works towards is the aim

explanation.surface: The goal is to do the editing in the morning.
explanation.definitionFit: To amend a text is to correct or alter it.

clue.text: Running about, a large number are in pain

indicators.note: are in means the large number sits inside the word for pain

parts.note: a sting is a sharp pain
a ream is a large quantity, as in reams of paper

explanation.surface: Lots of people dashing about are suffering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is link padding here; the container signal is 'are in'.
explanation.definitionFit: Streaming eyes or noses are running with fluid.

clue.text: Coloured like a lady butterfly

explanation.surface: Someone's face is coloured like a lady's, or like a butterfly's wings.
explanation.definitionFit: Coloured with paint is one sense; the painted lady is a familiar orange-and-black butterfly.

clue.text: Heathen making a god out of silver

indicators.note: made out of means the god's name has the metal set within it

parts.note: Pan is the Greek god of the wild
AG is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: An unbeliever fashions an idol from silver.
explanation.definitionFit: A pagan follows a religion other than the main world faiths, an unbeliever.

clue.text: Transcribe misprint without hesitation — and in French too!

indicators.note: without means outside, so the misprinted letters go round the hesitation

parts.note: a mis-print of print gives its five letters wrongly ordered
er is a sound of hesitation
et is French for and

explanation.surface: Someone copies out a misprint fluently, and in French as well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'misprint' is read as mis-print, the word print with its letters wrongly set; 'without' means outside rather than lacking; 'too' is padding.
explanation.definitionFit: To render a text or music in another form, as a translator or performer does.

clue.text: Like toothpaste, it's coming out upside down

indicators.note: upside down in a down clue means the word for coming out is read from the bottom up

parts.note: a debut is a coming out, a first appearance

explanation.surface: Toothpaste comes out when the tube is held upside down.
explanation.definitionFit: Toothpaste comes packed in a tube.

clue.text: At bottom find running water a nuisance

parts.note: the Dee is a river, water that runs
a pest is a nuisance

explanation.surface: Someone finds the stream at the bottom of the garden a bother.
explanation.definitionFit: In one's deepest heart means fundamentally, at the very root.

clue.text: Where a high-flying couple bring up their youngsters

definitions.text: Where a high-flying couple bring up their youngsters

parts.words: Where a high-flying couple bring up their youngsters
parts.note: reads like ambitious parents raising children, but the high flyers are a pair of eagles and the home is their nest on a crag

explanation.surface: A successful career couple raising their children.
explanation.definitionFit: An eagle's nest, built high on a cliff where the pair rear their chicks.

clue.text: Most Conservatives have a list that can be corrected

indicators.note: most of means the last letter of the word for Conservatives is dropped

parts.note: the political Right are the Conservatives
a table is a list set out in columns

explanation.surface: Most Tories have a list of things needing correction.
explanation.definitionFit: Something rightable is capable of being put right, set straight or amended.

clue.text: In debt, it's concluded pinched

parts.note: when something has concluded it is over
a pinched face looks drawn, thin and strained

explanation.surface: Someone in debt says the matter is closed, looking pinched.
explanation.definitionFit: A bank account taken below zero leaves the holder owing money.

clue.text: Go on about a key causing a bulge

indicators.note: about means the phrase for go on wraps round the letter for the key

parts.note: to ride is to go on a horse or vehicle
G is a musical key

explanation.surface: Someone carries on about a piano key that is sticking up.
explanation.definitionFit: A ridge is a raised strip or protrusion on a surface.

clue.text: Demand is critical

explanation.surface: Demanding work is critical work.
explanation.definitionFit: To exact is to insist on payment; exact also means precise and rigorously careful.

clue.text: Coaches musicians in a military company

parts.note: a train is made of coaches, carriages
a band is a group of musicians

explanation.surface: Musicians are drilled within an army unit.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainband was a citizen militia unit in Tudor and Stuart England.

clue.text: Signal to bring in a social worker

parts.note: to import goods is to bring them into a country
the ant is a social insect, and the workers do the colony's labour

explanation.surface: A sign is given to call in a social worker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Signal' here is the adjective, as in a signal victory.
explanation.definitionFit: A signal success is a notable, significant one.

clue.text: Quietly men accept a salary increase, the old hypocrites!

parts.note: P, piano, means quietly in music

indicators.note: accept means the word for men takes the following letters inside it

parts.note: hes are males, men
a rise is an increase in pay

explanation.surface: Men quietly take a pay rise and are called hypocrites.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pharisees were an ancient Jewish sect, branded hypocrites in the Gospels.

clue.text: Allegation made in a store's false

indicators.note: false means the letters of in a store's are given a false order

explanation.surface: A claim about a shop turns out untrue.
explanation.definitionFit: A claim or statement made confidently, often without proof.

clue.text: Flower is ready — hang as arranged

indicators.note: arranged means the letters of ready and hang are put in a new order, as a florist would

explanation.surface: The bloom is ready; hang it as it has been arranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A garden shrub with big round heads of blossom.

clue.text: His impediment of speech may be difficult to deal with

definitions.text: His impediment of speech may be difficult to deal with

parts.words: His impediment of speech may be difficult to deal with
parts.note: reads like a stammer, but the impediment is the one this person puts in a speaker's way

explanation.surface: A man's stammer can be awkward to handle.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who interrupts a speaker with taunts, obstructing the speech.

clue.text: Trumpeter's protruding teeth

parts.note: seems to be about a brass player's buck teeth, but the trumpeter is an elephant

explanation.surface: A trumpet player has prominent front teeth.
explanation.definitionFit: An elephant trumpets, and its long ivory teeth jut out from its mouth.

clue.text: It is in use at construction site

indicators.note: is in means the word it is placed within the rearranged letters
construction means the letters of use at are built into a new order

explanation.surface: It is being used on a building site.
explanation.walkthrough: 'construction' is the anagram signal, and 'is in' the container; the definition 'site' is the verb, to place.
explanation.definitionFit: To situate a building is to place or locate it.

clue.text: Pass over a Caribbean port

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
on means over, as in a lid on a box

explanation.surface: A ship goes past a harbour in the West Indies.
explanation.definitionFit: Colón in Panama sits at the Caribbean end of the canal.

clue.text: Place where something occurred — see, a copper's there

parts.note: lo is an old word for see, look
CU is the chemical symbol for copper, followed by the S of the apostrophe-s

explanation.surface: A crime scene: look, a policeman is on hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A locus is the exact spot or position of an event.

clue.text: Used to form a trap for the unwary six-footer

definitions.text: Used to form a trap for the unwary six-footer

parts.words: Used to form a trap for the unwary six-footer
parts.note: suggests a snare for a tall man, but the six-footer is an insect and the trap a spider's web

explanation.surface: Something is used to catch a careless very tall person.
explanation.definitionFit: The silk-producing organ through which a spider spins its web for catching insects.

clue.text: Piggish fellows taking only seconds over a drink

indicators.note: over in a down clue means this piece sits above the next

parts.note: wine is a drink

explanation.surface: Greedy men knock a drink back in seconds.
explanation.definitionFit: Swine is a term of abuse for nasty or greedy people, like pigs.

clue.text: The more pleasant part of the Napoleonic era

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A pleasanter stretch of Napoleon's times.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of nice: more agreeable.

clue.text: It's profitable to cut a liver into pieces

indicators.note: cut into pieces means the letters of cut a liver are chopped up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A butcher finds slicing liver a money-spinner.
explanation.definitionFit: Lucrative business yields good money.

clue.text: Church in a Far Eastern country

parts.note: CH is the abbreviation for church; that the letters also run unbroken across these words is a coincidence of the charade

explanation.surface: A church stands in an Asian nation.
explanation.definitionFit: The People's Republic in East Asia.

clue.text: Negotiated rise expected, so remains

indicators.note: negotiated means the letters of rise are worked into a new deal of order

parts.note: something due is expected, as a train due at noon

explanation.surface: A pay rise has been agreed and is expected, so the workers stay put.
explanation.walkthrough: 'remains' looks like a verb but is the noun: what is left over.
explanation.definitionFit: What is left behind after the rest is gone, leftover matter.

clue.text: Foreign way to put in order

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
to range things is to set them out in rows or order

explanation.surface: An alien method of tidying things up.
explanation.definitionFit: Foreign in the sense of unfamiliar or alien to one's experience.
